title: Green Horizon Educational Booklet: Drones & Climate Storytelling
description: Comprehensive educational syllabus providing youth workers, formal educators, and youth leaders with actionable methodologies to integrate drone piloting, ecological monitoring, and ethical digital media production into non-formal youth education.
modules: Module 01: European Climate Reality & Youth Perspectives
Module 02: Fundamentals of UAV Technology & Flight Physics
Module 03: Legal Compliance & EASA Open Category Regulations
Module 04: Aerial Photography & Cinematic Composition
Module 05: Environmental Data Collection & Visual Storytelling
Module 06: Non-Formal Workshop Blueprints & Safety Protocols

title: Drone Flight Safety Protocol & Field Checklist
description: A field-ready reference card detailing pre-flight risk assessment, airspace authorization verification, weather limits, battery lifecycle maintenance, and ethical privacy safeguards for youth fieldwork.
modules: Pre-flight inspection routine (18-point checklist)
Airspace awareness & geofencing guidelines
Emergency landing and failsafe procedures
GDPR & privacy in public aerial filming

title: Climate Storytelling & Digital Video Production Guide
description: Practical guide on crafting emotionally engaging digital narratives around environmental degradation and grassroots climate adaptation using mobile tools and aerial footage.
modules: Narrative arcs for environmental advocacy
Color grading aerial footage for documentary realism
Accessible subtitling and multilingual voiceover
Social media dissemination strategies for youth impact

title: Curator's Guide to 360° Virtual Reality Climate Exhibitions
description: Technical documentation for hosting immersive 360° virtual and physical hybrid exhibitions in youth centres, schools, and cultural galleries using open web standards.
modules: Capturing equirectangular 360-degree aerial images
Deploying interactive web-based panorama players
Cardboard VR headset and smartphone setups for schools
Interactive hotspot curation with youth audio testimonials

title: Local Youth Workshop Facilitator Kit
description: Ready-to-use pedagogical scenarios, icebreakers, hands-on flight exercises, and evaluation rubrics tailored for youth workers running 2-day climate media workshops.
modules: Icebreaker: 'The Earth from Above' visual trivia
Flight Simulator Challenge: Indoor micro-drone navigation
Citizen Science: Identifying local ecological hot-spots
Team Media Sprint: Editing a 60-second climate micro-reel
